title: We rewrote our Rust WASM parser in TypeScript and it got faster

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: We rewrote our Rust WASM parser in TypeScript — and it’s 3x faster than before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This matters because performance is the new standard for web apps.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: We built a parser that translates complex data into JavaScript objects.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: TypeScript’s compiler optimizations made the code run smoother and faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects developers using WASM in real-time apps like analytics and games.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway: Sometimes, rewriting in a different language can unlock massive speed gains.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Try it yourself — have you ever seen a JS parser outperform Rust?
